name: Youth Council, Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
org: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts (PAFA)
what_you_do: Meet weekly after school at PAFA to make art and talk about it. You plan events for teens at the museum, work with staff and help with a teen art magazine.
pay_detail: Free to join. No pay or stipend is stated.
duration: Fall 2026: Wednesdays Oct 21 to Dec 9, 4 to 6 pm. Spring 2027: Wednesdays Jan 27 to Apr 14, 4 to 6 pm.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 starts Oct 21, 2026; Spring 2027 starts Jan 27, 2027. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Register link on the Youth Council page.
notes: PAFA is on North Broad Street. The status is shown as open because the page lists a Register link for both sessions; the page gives no closing date.
